question: What is the main role of commercial banks in the economy?
solution:
The correct answer is 1) **__Promoting economic growth and development__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main role of commercial banks in the economy is to **promote economic growth and development.**
 
• Commercial banks **collect people's savings and provide loans**, which helps in economic development.
 
• These banks also provide various financial services such **as credit cards, debit cards, and investment services**.
 
• Commercial banks provide financial assistance to **business and industry,** which increases employment opportunities and accelerates economic growth.
 
• These banks also play an important role in implementing **monetary and credit policy, **which helps in maintaining economic stability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commercial banks provide interest on the amount deposited**, which encourages people to save more.
 
• These banks promote financial inclusion, allowing all sections of society to benefit from banking services.
 
• Commercial banks also provide assistance to **foreign trade,** which strengthens the economic condition of the country.
 
• Services provided by these banks such as **bank guarantees and letters of credit help** in smooth running of business activities.
 
• Commercial banks also play a vital role in the **financial markets,** smoothening the flow of capital and increasing investment opportunities.
